$comment: DESIGN.md §6.2 and §6.4. This file is the deliverable, not the scaffolding around it. Values are game units, not SI: what matters is monotonicity and consistent ratios (§6.2). `class` is taxonomy only and has no mechanical effect. `formation` is carried for §7.1 layer 6 and is deliberately not packed into the simulation yet — worldgen is M2. `solidify` is a downward phase crossing; see sim/src/material.rs for why the §6.2 schema needs it.

materials.$comment: §6.2's worked example, kept as authored except for the melt point. The document's -20 makes the material a liquid at any habitable temperature, which is not what the surrounding prose describes; 45 keeps it solid in hand and liquid near a forge, which is the behaviour §6.3 promises.
Refined quartz: the aether is what the reduction strips out, so it is a better abrasive and a worse conduit.
Dissolving it is strongly endothermic. A flask of water plus a handful of this is a cold weapon and nobody wrote a cold weapon.
Almost nothing gets through it. Shielding, and a terrible wand.
The battery: enormous capacity with a high threshold, so it holds charge instead of shedding it.
The alloy of copper and tin — harder than either parent and tougher than iron. §7.4 wants alloy curves with local optima; this is the peak of one.

The anti-correlated outlier §6.2 asks for: hard AND tough, conductive AND permeable. It was never authored as a legendary item, it is just a rock that landed wrong. Abundance is near zero for a reason.
Toughness 0.95 against hardness 0.12 — the opposite corner of the property space from obsidian, and the reason a maul is useless against it.
Hardness up sevenfold, toughness down twelvefold. Nothing implements 'freeze then shatter'; this row is the whole mechanism.

Condenses back into hoarfrost quartz 200 degrees below where the quartz boils. A cycle, deliberately — the wide gap makes it a slow geological loop rather than an oscillation, and its net latent energy is exactly zero so tools/fuzz.ts passes it.
Huge capacity, low threshold: it will not hold what it can carry, so it sheds constantly. Harvested from creatures and anomalies; §8.3's socket contents.
An unstable intermediate: it ignites at 60, barely above ambient, and releases more than any other row. Nothing calls it an explosive. It is one reaction product with one low ignition point.
